task.name: Ralph Single Iteration
task.objective: Execute a single iteration of the Ralph 5-phase micro-pipeline

llm.mandate: Execute ONE task through the 5-phase pipeline: PLAN → TEST → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX
Spawn fresh subagent for each phase with NO conversation history carried over
All state flows through disk files (PLAN.md, scratchpad.md, etc.)
Run backpressure gates (tests) after implementation phase
Handle failures with checkpoint rollback when configured (worktree primary, stash fallback)
Track token usage and cost for each phase

input.name: task_index
input.desc: Index of task in PLAN.md (for marking done)

input.name: phases
input.desc: Phase configuration (enabled, backend, preset for each)

input.name: approve_mode
input.desc: If true, pause for human approval at gates

input.name: auto_commit
input.desc: If true, create git commits for iteration completion

input.name: skip_empty_commits
input.desc: If true, skip iteration commits when nothing is staged

input.name: goal_spec_path
input.desc: Path to goal_spec JSON describing completion criteria. Rendered into phase prompts and used to emit verdict + goal_text in orch:session_complete telemetry. See docs/goal-spec.md.

step.title: Render Goal Spec
step.action:
If goal_spec_path is set and the file exists: ```bash # Render universal prompt block (appended to all phase prompts below) scripts/render-goal-spec.sh --spec "{goal_spec_path}" --target prompt \ > "{state_dir}/iterations/{iteration:03d}-goal-prompt.md"
# Capture goal_text for telemetry GOAL_TEXT=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('{goal_spec_path}'))['goal_spec']['outcome'])") ```
Store GOAL_TEXT and goal-prompt path in session.json for step 8/9 telemetry
If goal_spec_path not set: skip (backward-compatible — workflows without a spec keep current behavior)

step.title: Initialize Iteration
step.action: Read session.json from {state_dir} to get current state
Read GUARDRAILS.md from {state_dir} for project rules
Read scratchpad.md from {state_dir} for cross-iteration context
Read handoff.md from {state_dir} if it exists (carries context from previous phase)
If handoff.md exists, set handoff_content template variable with its content
Create iteration log file: {state_dir}/iterations/{iteration:03d}.log
Update session.json: current_iteration = {iteration}
Log: "=== Iteration {iteration}: {task} ==="

If goal prompt block exists (from step 0), append its contents to every phase prompt assembled in steps 3-7 (PLAN/TEST/IMPLEMENT/REVIEW/FIX). The goal block is the LAST section of each prompt so it survives any truncation.

check.action: Try worktree snapshot: - Execute: git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration} HEAD - If successful: store worktree path in session.json, set checkpoint_mode = "worktree" - Log: "Worktree snapshot created: ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}"
Log warning: "Worktree unavailable, falling back to stash snapshot"
Execute: git stash push --include-untracked -m "ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}"
Store stash name in session.json, set checkpoint_mode = "stash"
Execute: git stash pop (restore working tree — stash is kept as named ref)
Log: "Stash snapshot created: ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}"
Log: "--- Phase: PLAN ---"

Resolve constraints for phase=plan: - global_cannot_do = constraints.global.cannot_do - phase_cannot_do = constraints.phases.plan.cannot_do - phase_must_do = merge(constraints.global.must_do, constraints.phases.plan.must_do)
Build prompt from iteration-prompt.md template with phase=plan
Inject status block instruction via inject_status_instruction(prompt)
Include: task description, scratchpad.md content, story context (if BMAD mode)
Capture approach from subagent output
Append approach to scratchpad.md: ``` ## Iteration {iteration} - Plan {approach} ```
Track cost: record input/output tokens for plan phase
Write handoff.md to {state_dir} using handoff.md.tpl template: - from_phase: plan - to_phase: test (or implement if test disabled) - Include: approach decisions, edge cases found, files identified
Display approach to user
HALT and wait for user approval
If rejected: mark task as skipped, return early
Log: "--- Phase: TEST (ATDD - RED) ---"

Resolve constraints for phase=test: - global_cannot_do = constraints.global.cannot_do - phase_cannot_do = constraints.phases.test.cannot_do - phase_must_do = merge(constraints.global.must_do, constraints.phases.test.must_do)
Build prompt from tea-test-prompt.md template with phase=test

Resolve TEA knowledge context: - Detect stack type (scan for package.json → frontend, pyproject.toml → backend, both → fullstack) - Load condensed knowledge: try {phases.test.tea_knowledge_path} first, then orchestrator/data/tea-knowledge-condensed.md - If neither file exists: log warning "TEA knowledge file not found, proceeding without knowledge injection" and set {{tea_knowledge_context}} to empty - Otherwise inject full condensed knowledge into {{tea_knowledge_context}} (file is compact at ~170 lines)
Build prompt from iteration-prompt.md template with phase=test
Include: task description, approach from plan phase
Identify new test file created
Record test_file path for implement phase
Track cost: record input/output tokens for test phase
Write handoff.md to {state_dir} using handoff.md.tpl template: - from_phase: test - to_phase: implement - Include: test file path, test strategy, expected failure behavior
Log warning: "Tests passed before implementation - test may be incomplete"
Continue anyway (test might be verifying existing behavior)
Log: "Running TEA quality gate on test files"

Parse quality score from JSON output: - If valid JSON with quality_score field: use the score - If invalid JSON or missing quality_score: log warning "TEA quality gate returned invalid output, treating as advisory skip" and set quality_score = -1 (skip threshold check)
Track cost: record input/output tokens for quality gate evaluation
Log warning: "TEA quality score {quality_score} below threshold {gates.test_quality.threshold}"
Append quality recommendations to scratchpad.md
Log: "TEA quality gate passed: {quality_score}/{gates.test_quality.threshold}"

step.title: Phase 2: IMPLEMENT
step.action: Log: "--- Phase: IMPLEMENT ---"

Resolve constraints for phase=implement: - global_cannot_do = constraints.global.cannot_do - phase_cannot_do = constraints.phases.implement.cannot_do - phase_must_do = merge(constraints.global.must_do, constraints.phases.implement.must_do)
Build prompt from iteration-prompt.md template with phase=implement
Inject status block instruction via inject_status_instruction(prompt)
Include: task description, approach, test_file path (if ATDD)
Track cost: record input/output tokens for implement phase
Write handoff.md to {state_dir} using handoff.md.tpl template: - from_phase: implement - to_phase: review - Include: files changed, implementation decisions, known limitations

check.action: Re-run tests once (silent retry for flake detection)

check.if: tests still failed AND phases.implement.tea_healing = true
check.action: Log: "Tests failed after implementation - attempting TEA self-healing"
Capture test failure output for healing prompt
Re-run tests after healing
Log: "TEA self-healing succeeded after implementation"
Increment retry_count
Log: "Implementation failed after {retry_count} retries"
Execute: git checkout -- . (discard worktree changes, worktree is disposable)
Execute: git stash apply ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}
Mark task as BLOCKED in PLAN.md
Return with status=blocked
Log: "Tests failed, retrying implementation (attempt {retry_count})"
GOTO step 5 (retry implement phase)

step.action: Log: "Implementation passed tests"

check.action: Log: "--- Phase: REVIEW ---"

Resolve constraints for phase=review: - global_cannot_do = constraints.global.cannot_do - phase_cannot_do = constraints.phases.review.cannot_do - phase_must_do = merge(constraints.global.must_do, constraints.phases.review.must_do)
Execute: git diff HEAD to get changes
Store diff for review prompt
Build prompt from iteration-prompt.md template with phase=review
Inject status block instruction via inject_status_instruction(prompt)
Include: task description, git diff
Parse review output for: - has_issues: boolean - issues: array of {severity, category, file, line, description, suggestion} - summary: string
Track cost: record input/output tokens for review phase
Write handoff.md to {state_dir} using handoff.md.tpl template: - from_phase: review - to_phase: fix (or commit if no issues) - Include: issues found, severity assessment, fix guidance
Display review summary to user
HALT and wait for user approval to commit
If rejected: return for manual review
Proceed to FIX phase (step 7)
Skip FIX phase, proceed to commit (step 8)
Initialize fix_attempts = 0

loop.action: Resolve constraints for phase=fix: - global_cannot_do = constraints.global.cannot_do - phase_cannot_do = constraints.phases.fix.cannot_do - phase_must_do = merge(constraints.global.must_do, constraints.phases.fix.must_do)
Build prompt from iteration-prompt.md template with phase=fix
Inject status block instruction via inject_status_instruction(prompt)
Track cost: record input/output tokens for fix phase
Write handoff.md to {state_dir} using handoff.md.tpl template: - from_phase: fix - to_phase: review (re-review) - Include: fixes applied, remaining concerns, test results

check.action: Log: "Tests failed after fix - silent retry for flake detection"

check.if: tests still failed AND phases.fix.tea_healing = true
check.action: Log: "Tests failed after retry - attempting TEA self-healing"
Capture test failure output for healing prompt
Log: "TEA self-healing succeeded"
Log: "TEA self-healing failed - proceeding to rollback"
Log: "Fix broke tests, rolling back to checkpoint"
Execute: git checkout .claude/worktrees/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration} -- .
Log: "Rolled back to worktree snapshot"
Execute: git checkout -- .
Execute: git stash apply "stash@{/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}}"
Log: "Rolled back to stash snapshot"
Mark task as BLOCKED in PLAN.md
Return with status=blocked, reason="Fix broke tests"

loop.action: Re-run review phase (abbreviated): - Get new diff - Spawn review subagent - Parse for has_issues

check.action: Log: "All issues resolved"
Exit fix loop
Log: "Could not resolve all issues after {fix_attempts} attempts"
Mark task as NEEDS_MANUAL in PLAN.md
Append unresolved issues to scratchpad.md

step.title: Commit and Mark Done
step.action: Log: "--- Finalizing Task ---"
Read PLAN.md
Replace "- [ ] {task}" with "- [x] {task} *(Iteration {iteration})*"
Write updated PLAN.md
Update cost-tracker.json with this iteration's usage

check.action: Log: "--- Committing ---"
Execute: git add -A
Check staged diff with: git diff --cached --quiet
Execute: git commit -m "{commit_message}"
Capture commit hash
Log: "Task completed: {commit_hash}"
Set commit_hash = ""
Log: "Task completed with no commit (nothing staged)"
Execute: git commit -m "{commit_message}"
Capture commit hash
Log: "Task completed: {commit_hash}"
Set commit_hash = ""
Log: "Task completed without git commit (auto_commit disabled)"

step.title: Circuit Breaker Check
step.action: Check circuit breaker state using CircuitBreaker.check() with iteration result: - iteration: {iteration} - files_modified: count of files changed this iteration - test_output: last test output (for error hash) - output_tokens: tokens used this iteration - cost_usd: cost of this iteration from cost tracker - test_only: whether only test files were modified

check.action: Log: "CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED: {circuit_breaker.trip_reason}"
Write trip reason to session.json: circuit_breaker_trip = {circuit_breaker.trip_reason}
Update session.json status to "halted"
Return with status=halted, reason=circuit_breaker.trip_reason
Log: "Circuit breaker HALF_OPEN: probe iteration allowed with reduced scope"

step.title: Parse Status Block
step.action: Parse status block from last phase output using parse_status_block()

check.action: Log: "Status block: {status_block.status}, files={status_block.files_modified}, tests={status_block.tests_status}"
Feed status block data into circuit breaker (files_modified, tests_status)
Log: "Exit signal received: {status_block.recommendation}"
Write exit signal to session.json
Log warning: "No status block in agent output — falling back to schema parsing"

step.title: Cleanup

check.action: Remove worktree snapshot (no longer needed): git worktree remove .claude/worktrees/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration} --force
Drop checkpoint stash (no longer needed): git stash drop "stash@{/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}}"

step.action: Update session.json with iteration results

Compute VERDICT from iteration status: ``` status=completed AND all gates passed AND has_issues=false → VERDICT=PASS status=blocked OR status=needs_manual → VERDICT=BLOCKED anything else → VERDICT=FAIL ```
Append to {state_dir}/events.ndjson: ```json {"event":"orch:iteration_complete","session_id":"{session_id}","iteration":{iteration},"verdict":"{VERDICT}","goal_text":"{GOAL_TEXT}","ts":""} ```

check.if: VERDICT = PASS AND goal_spec_path is set
check.action: Call your memory-store MCP tool (if available) with: - scope: "project" - entry_type: "reusable_pattern" - payload: {"name":"ralph-iterate:{task}", "goal_spec":<contents of goal_spec_path>, "iterations_used":1, "session_id":"{session_id}"}
If MCP unavailable, append the same record to {state_dir}/patterns.ndjson for batch ingestion later

step.action: Check for completion signal in PLAN.md

check.action: Write completion signal: <!-- RALPH_COMPLETE: true -->

output.name: success
output.desc: True if task completed and committed

output.name: tokens_used
output.desc: Cost of this iteration in USD

output.name: input_tokens
output.desc: Total input tokens across all phases

output.name: output_tokens
output.desc: Total output tokens across all phases

output.name: fix_attempts
output.desc: How many fix iterations were needed

output.name: unresolved_issues
output.desc: Any issues not resolved after fix attempts

on_error.action: If checkpoint_mode = "worktree": Execute git checkout .claude/worktrees/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration} -- . (restore from snapshot)
If checkpoint_mode = "stash": Execute git checkout -- . && git stash apply "stash@{/ralph-checkpoint-{iteration}}" (restore from stash)
on_error.message: Iteration {iteration} failed - rolled back to checkpoint

backend.name: claude
backend.tool: Task (if session=claude) OR Bash codex exec (if session=glm) — NO backend switching
backend.bash_command: LOG_FILE="{state_dir}/iterations/{iteration:03d}-{phase}.log" # Was: claude -p "{prompt}" — rerouted to codex exec (June-15 subscription cliff). codex exec "{prompt}" > "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

backend.name: cg_d
backend.tool: Task (if session=glm) OR Bash (if session=claude) — NO backend switching
